competing_explanations.statement: Hot Canadian labor/underlying inflation, strong US nominal data or BoC validation can justify more tightening and push the strip higher.
Energy relief can reduce inflation pressure but also improve demand; peace does not mechanically determine the policy path.
Equity stress may stay sector-specific; a wider credit/growth shock could remove more hikes. Forced liquidation/funding stress can initially hurt receivers.
The limited central remaining payoff may not justify retained risk; the larger favorable scenario is plausible but less likely and not probabilistically estimated.
